snippet.title: House of Saturn - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for House of Saturn, a retro horror game developed by Cathedra Games. Players will embody an exorcist trapped overnight in a haunted university building where demons stalk the environment, and the only escape is the uncovering of a sinister plot. Solve puzzles, scavenge for supplies, and survive House of Saturn, coming soon to PC (Steam).
